label: Kinds of shift
subgoals: List the design, node, tool and constraint inputs behind the label
Ask which of them differ in deployment
Plan a measurement for each difference

label: Measuring generalization by design
subgoals: Hold out each design in turn and train on the rest
Average the held-out errors for the estimate
Report the spread and the worst fold with the mean

label: Living with shift
subgoals: Monitor feature distance or ensemble disagreement at run time
Fall back to the accurate engine when shift is detected
Keep adaptation data separate from evaluation data
